thread:
Isha Patel: LegalFlow POC kickoff. Scope = contract search + two tool calls (create_invoice, mark_dispute). Customer asks for SOW, success metrics, model/context recommendation, and committed pricing for ~10k q/day. Demo in 10 business days.

Marco Ruiz: suggested success metrics: precision@5 >= 0.80 on their labeled legal-query set, E2E tool-call correctness >= 95% (schema + side-effect verification), search-path p95 < 500ms, and no PII exposure in results. Add a cost cap per query.

Dana V.: model fit recs: try 32k-context family for long contracts; if token-cost/latency too high, fallback to 16k + chunking. Pipeline: ingestion -> embeddings ANN -> prompt-based rerank -> generator that builds validated tool payloads. Consider quantized small reranker after prompt baseline.

Priya N.: timeline: Days 0-2 connectors + canonical prompts (need 50 labeled prompts from LegalFlow), Days 3-6 embed+index+recall checks, Days 7-8 rerank tuning & prompts, Day9 tool integration+E2E smoke, Day10 demo.

Marco Ruiz: embedding sizing estimate: ~170k docs, avg 3KB -> ~510M tokens. Start 768-d embeddings; move to 1024-d if recall suffers. Recommend nightly incremental refresh + webhook-trigger for invoice events.

Isha Patel: pricing ask: provide two proposals — Hosted metered example and Reserved monthly commit (lower unit price + SLA). Example calc: 10k q/day ~ 300k q/mo. Finance to give committed tier numbers.

Dana V.: sample curl for POC engineer:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/semsearch -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"query":"How do I dispute a clause in my contract?","top_k":60,"rerank":true,"model":"rwd-32k-search"}'
```

InfraBot: LEGALFLOW-POC-2130012345 created, infra ticket INF-9277 opened, service account provisioned, KMS onboarding pending customer auth.

Isha Patel: blockers to call out: (1) filled security questionnaire & SSO test creds, (2) finance signoff on committed pricing, (3) sample docs for latency validation on 32k. Priya please draft SOW with acceptance criteria, rollback to 16k/8k chunking, and prompt-eval plan (50 labeled prompts).

Priya N.: will do. adding instrumentation list: precision@1/5, recall@10, avg tokens/query, token cost, p95 latency, tool-call success rate, and PII redaction FP/FN. I'll flag the canary rollback criteria (quality drop >5%). Next sync Tue 11am PT. :white_check_mark:
